solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Joker Georgia makes two appearances in town down under

indicators.note: the pair of pieces is to be written out twice, one copy after the other

parts.note: a wag is a joker or wit
GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: A comedian from Georgia keeps turning up in some Australian town.
explanation.walkthrough: WAGGA WAGGA is a town in New South Wales, Australia; 'down under' is the usual nickname for Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: The New South Wales town is in Australia, which is called the land down under.

clue.text: End of meadow that is most spread out

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, here taken from the meadow

parts.note: id est is the Latin for 'that is', abbreviated i.e.

explanation.surface: The far end of a field is where it stretches out the most.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of wide, meaning broadest or most extensive in spread.

clue.text: Control Tory minister has got over our navy

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sitting over another is placed above it, so written first

parts.note: Michael Gove was a Conservative cabinet minister
RN is the Royal Navy, the British setter's own navy

explanation.surface: A Conservative minister has taken charge of Britain's fleet.
explanation.definitionFit: To govern is to rule or exercise control over something, a straight verb synonym.

clue.text: Comprehensive with everyone touchy-feely?

parts.note: all means everyone together
someone touchy-feely is given to hugging, i.e. embracing

explanation.surface: An inclusive approach where everybody is hugging one another.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful reading of 'touchy-feely' as literally embracing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that takes in everything is wide-ranging and inclusive, which is the sense of comprehensive.

clue.text: Car valuation regularly offered

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word valuation, here the second, fourth, sixth and eighth

explanation.surface: A vehicle valuation being offered on a regular basis.
explanation.definitionFit: Auto is a common short form of automobile, a motor car.

clue.text: Like source of energy making the gal more frisky

indicators.note: frisky means lively and jumping about, so the letters of the phrase are set in a new order

explanation.surface: Something about power generation that makes a girl more playful.
explanation.definitionFit: Geothermal describes heat drawn from inside the earth, used as a source of power.

clue.text: Writer or his son wrong not to finish

indicators.note: the word for wrong loses its final letter, so it does not reach its finish

parts.note: amiss means wrong or faulty

explanation.surface: A novelist, or perhaps his child, made a mistake by not completing something.
explanation.walkthrough: Kingsley Amis and his son Martin Amis were both British novelists, so the definition works for either.
explanation.definitionFit: Kingsley and his son Martin share this surname and were both celebrated novelists.

clue.text: Pole, old fellow perceived of as a big beast

parts.note: a mast is a tall pole on a ship
a don is a fellow of a university college

explanation.surface: A Polish elderly man seen as a large animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' at the start looks like a Polish person; it is a mast. 'perceived of as' just links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastodon was a huge extinct elephant-like mammal, certainly a big animal.

clue.text: Mushroom mum and I swallow around lunchtime?

parts.note: keep mum means stay quiet, and sh is the call for silence
one o'clock is around lunchtime, written as the Roman numeral I for one
to take a pill or drink is to swallow it

explanation.surface: Mother and I eat a fungus at about midday.
explanation.walkthrough: The extra I comes from reading 'lunchtime' as one o'clock, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiitake is an edible fungus popular in East Asian cooking.

clue.text: In county one has nasty lout leading delegation

indicators.note: In means the following pieces go inside the county's name

parts.note: Devon is an English county in the south-west

indicators.note: nasty suggests the word lout is spoilt and jumbled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: In an English county someone has a horrible yob in charge of a delegation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nasty' makes OLUT and 'In' sets it, with the numeral, inside the south-western English county; 'leading' only links, so the definition is just 'delegation'.
explanation.definitionFit: Devolution is the handing down of powers from central to regional government, i.e. delegation.

clue.text: Champagne substitute used in toasting?

indicators.note: used in means the run of letters is found inside the word toasting

explanation.surface: Something drunk instead of champagne when raising a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is an Italian sparkling wine often drunk as a cheaper alternative to champagne.

clue.text: Effect of drunkenness that could make Ned oblivious

indicators.note: could make means the letters of the phrase can be built into something new

explanation.surface: A drunken man named Ned might end up seeing things twice.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing two of everything is a familiar symptom of having had too much to drink.

clue.text: Little fellow is about to meet politician — hour for engagement

indicators.note: the hour is engaged, held inside the turned word, as if locked in
about signals that the word is is turned round

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A small man is about to see his MP and has an hour booked for the appointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' gives SI and 'for engagement' sets the hour within it; 'engagement' reads like an appointment, but here it means being held inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrimp is an informal, slightly mocking word for a small or slight person.

clue.text: Reject that could give indication of worth

parts.words: that could give indication of worth
parts.note: read as a clue, the two words are an anagram of worth followed by out as its anagram signal, so they lead to the word worth

explanation.surface: Something that shows what a thing is worth is discarded.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a reverse clue: the answer, read as its own clue, rearranges THROW to give WORTH.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw out a proposal is to reject it or dismiss it.

clue.text: Doing things to keep off drink, artist appealing to others

indicators.note: to keep means the active word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: active means busy doing things
TT, teetotal, describes someone off alcohol
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A busy painter who has given up alcohol is attractive to other people.
explanation.definitionFit: Something attractive has appeal and draws people in, so it appeals to others.

clue.text: Irritating folk play modern music for Spooner — a hindrance to creative work

indicators.note: Spooner swaps the opening sounds of two words, as the Reverend Spooner famously did

parts.note: blighters are annoying people
to rock is to play rock music

explanation.surface: Annoying people playing pop music get in the way of an artist's work.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the BL and R sounds of BLIGHTERS ROCK gives RIGHTERS BLOCK, said like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Writer's block is an inability to produce new work, a barrier to creativity.

clue.text: Quiet agent a Communist tooled up for assignment?

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
a rep is a sales representative, an agent
red is the usual label for a communist

explanation.surface: A quiet spy and a Communist armed and ready for a mission.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark hints at an armed agent on a mission, but the definition simply means ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Being equipped and ready for a task is to be ready in advance for it.

clue.text: Individual with record time raking in cash

indicators.note: raking in means gathering something inside, so the cash word is drawn into the others

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
tin is old slang for money

explanation.surface: A person setting a record time while gathering money.
explanation.definitionFit: Distinct means separate and individual, standing apart from others.

clue.text: A terraced inn, done up and given a new lease of life

definitions.text: given a new lease of life

indicators.note: done up means renovated or reworked, so the letters are set in a new order

explanation.surface: A pub in a row of houses refurbished and brought back to life.
explanation.definitionFit: Being reborn in a new body is a literal new lease of life.

clue.text: Mousy female's attire revealing thighs, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals a word that sounds like the one the wordplay gives

parts.note: a mini is a short skirt showing the thighs

explanation.surface: A timid woman wears a garment that shows her legs.
explanation.walkthrough: Minnie Mouse is the Disney cartoon partner of Mickey Mouse, hence 'Mousy female'; the 's is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Mickey's cartoon girlfriend is a female mouse in Disney animation.

clue.text: Fish that's hairy and ridiculous-looking?

definitions.meaning: a grey or red sea fish of coastal waters
a hairstyle short at the front and long at the back, often mocked

explanation.definitionFit: Both the fish and the much-mocked haircut, short at front and long behind, share this name.

clue.text: Advice to person with bad bruise is temporarily withheld

definitions.text: Advice to person with bad bruise
definitions.meaning: cold applied to a bruise reduces the swelling
kept in reserve or shelved for later

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: chilling a bruise to soothe it, and the idiom of shelving something for later.

clue.text: Environment of one place miles further west

indicators.note: in an across clue further west is further left, so the miles letter goes in front

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
lieu means place, as in 'in lieu of'

explanation.surface: Surroundings of a spot a few miles further to the west.
explanation.definitionFit: A milieu is someone's social setting or surroundings.

clue.text: Drug helps to give them power

indicators.note: the two words together help to give, i.e. contain, the run of letters across them

explanation.surface: A narcotic helps make them powerful.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemp is cannabis, a plant used as a drug.

clue.text: Revolting row

definitions.meaning: a line, as of soldiers or taxis

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: foul and offensive, and a line of people or things such as a taxi stand.

clue.text: I am silent, nodding ultimately? Wrong — alert!

indicators.note: wrong means the letters are put together in the wrong order
ultimately means the last letter of nodding

explanation.surface: Someone protests that they are quiet and dozing off, but it is a false alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes G from nodding, added to IAMSILENT before 'Wrong' rearranges the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadcast time signal, such as the pips, is an audible alert marking the exact hour.

clue.text: Fruit lover?

definitions.meaning: the sweet fruit of a palm tree
a romantic partner one goes out with

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the palm-tree fruit, and the companion one meets for a romantic evening.

clue.text: Hopeless northern haunt in the grip of tyrant

indicators.note: in the grip of means held inside the tyrant word

parts.note: a despot is a tyrant
a den is a hangout or haunt

explanation.surface: A gloomy northern hideout controlled by a dictator.
explanation.definitionFit: Despondent means dejected and without hope.
